identity.title: Sub-kpc star formation law in the local luminous infrared galaxy IC 4687 as seen by ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We obtained new ALMA $^{12}$CO(2–1) observations with $\sim$100 pc spatial resolution to study the SF law in IC 4687.

evidence.quote: we study the local ($d$=74 Mpc; 345 pc arcsec$^{-1}$) luminous IR galaxy (LIRG) IC 4687.

question.value: How does the sub-kpc (250 pc) and integrated star formation law of the local LIRG IC 4687 compare with normal nearby galaxies and high-z galaxies?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present one of the first sub-kpc analyses of the SF law in a local extreme starburst.
(project 2013.1.00271.S; PI: L. Colina)
We obtained band 6 observations of IC 4687 with ALMA on August 28 2014 and April 5 2015

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Two 1.875 GHz spws at CO(2–1) (226.4 GHz) and CS(5–4) (240.7 GHz), 0.48 MHz channels; continuum spws at 228.6 and 243.4 GHz

evidence.quote: Two spectral windows of 1.875 GHz bandwidth (0.48 MHz $\sim$ 0.6 km/s channels) were centered at the sky frequencies of $^{12}$CO(2–1) (226.4 GHz) and CS(5–4) (240.7 GHz).
centered at the sky frequencies of $^{12}$CO(2–1) (226.4 GHz)

evidence.quote: using extended and compact antenna array configurations with 35 and 39 antennas, respectively

analysis_steps.goal: Define regions and measure CO and Paα

method.value: 10 sigma peaks in CO and Paα maps; 0.7" (250 pc) apertures; 81 regions, 54 with Brγ and Brδ >6 sigma

evidence.quote: Emission peaks above a 10$\sigma$ level were considered.

key_parameters.value: Match radius 0.35"; spectra integrated over 5000–5400 km/s above 3 sigma

evidence.quote: we extracted their spectra and integrated all the channels above a 3$\sigma$ level within the velocity range of the CO(2–1) emission in this object (5000–5400 km s$^{-1}$)

analysis_steps.goal: Derive gas mass and SFR surface densities

method.value: H2 mass from CO(2-1) with alpha_CO=4.35 and R21=0.7; extinction-correct Paα using Brγ/Brδ, convert to SFR; correct by cos 47 deg

evidence.quote: using the Galactic CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor, $\alpha_{\rm CO}^{1-0}=4.35$

assumptions.value: Intrinsic Brγ/Brδ=1.52, F99 extinction law, Hα/Paα=8.58, Kroupa IMF, i=47 deg

evidence.quote: assumed an intrinsic Br$\gamma$/Br$\delta$ ratio of 1.52 (cite: Hummer1987) and the (cite: Fitzpatrick1999) extinction law

validation.value: Compared with Calzetti law, average extinction, AK vs NH2 relation, and IMF sampling via Starburst99

evidence.quote: We also tried the (cite: Calzetti2000) extinction law.

analysis_steps.goal: Compare with local and high-z SF laws and compute integrated properties

method.value: Compare with Leroy2008 and Casasola2015 data; power-law fit; integrated values over 3x3 kpc using Brγ-based SFR

evidence.quote: a nonlinear SF law fits the data with a power-law index of $N=1.6$

findings_qualitative.value: IC 4687 regions have depletion times about an order of magnitude shorter than nearby galaxies assuming Galactic alpha_CO

evidence.quote: This is approximately one order of magnitude shorter than in nearby galaxies, which is 1–2 Gyr

claims.hypothesis: Does IC 4687 follow the SF law of nearby galaxies at 250 pc scales?
claims.experiment: Compared ALMA CO and Paα-based SFR in 54 regions with Leroy2008 and Casasola2015
claims.result: Σ_SFR ~10 times higher at similar Σ_H2; tdep 160 Myr vs 1–2 Gyr
claims.finding: SF is more efficient in IC 4687, consistent with a bimodal SF law

evidence.quote: Our results suggest that SF is more efficient in IC 4687 than in nearby star-forming galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Is the local SF relation tight within IC 4687?
claims.experiment: Spearman correlation of Σ_H2 and Σ_SFR
claims.finding: The SF law breaks down at 250 pc or is hidden by scatter

evidence.quote: the correlation between the molecular gas and the SFR surface densities is weak ($r_{\rm S}=0.24$, $p=0.08$)

why_this_method.value: Galactic alpha_CO preferred since IC 4687 is a weakly interacting rotating spiral

evidence.quote: Therefore, we consider the Galactic $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ factor preferred for IC 4687.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: ULIRG-like alpha_CO rejected as it would make IC 4687 an extreme starburst

evidence.quote: In principle, we do not expect such extreme behavior in a weakly interacting spiral galaxy such as IC 4687.

limitations_admitted.value: Extinction and alpha_CO systematics; evolutionary state of regions cannot be tested

evidence.quote: With the current observations, however, it is not possible to establish the evolutionary state of the regions in IC 4687, so we cannot test this hypothesis.

referee_caveats_inferred: Conclusions depend strongly on the adopted alpha_CO
